ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with low-intensity (black) pixels occupying approximately 90-95% of the visible surface area and high-intensity (white) pixels localized in discrete clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of contiguous black pigmentation. Discrete high-contrast white blobs and rings are scattered across both lobes, with higher spatial density observed at the distal tips and along the trailing margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with a central convergence angle of approximately 65 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box offset.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the trailing edge, characterized by low-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys; texture is most pronounced and irregular at the left lobe's distal extremity.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal sweep exhibiting a concave curve at the notch base transitioning to a broad convexity across the mid-lobes, concluding with an upward-tilted distal sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular and ring-shaped white pixel clusters; highest concentration located on the distal portions of both lobes and clustered near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) across the ventral surface; irregular jagged trailing edge indicates minor historical physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: The white circular marks exhibit a specific 'ring-in-ring' or 'donut' morphology where a high-intensity perimeter surrounds a low-intensity center.
